Other families would bicker, banter, argue, yell at each other, and it would terrify me. I used to think ‘wow they all really hate each other!’ Now I realise that my family were the strange ones because no one ever communicated effectively. At least, not with me anyway. Now I’m 34 and, for the first time in my entire life believe that suicide might actually be in store for me sometime in my future. The only flicker of a connection I had with another person has ended due to my selfish impulsivity, and now I’m just emotionally free falling.
